Report the people each network, campaign, ad set, ad or surface brought in, and what they went on to
pay.

A person is credited to the touch that brought them within the attribution window before they signed
up. The period is the last 30 complete days unless --last or --from says otherwise, with days cut in
--timezone.

Usage:
  voidhash analytics acquisition [flags]

Flags:
      --ad <id>            Only people whose credited touch carried this ad id
      --adset <id>         Only people whose credited touch carried this ad set id
      --attribution-window-days <days>
                           How long before a signup a campaign touch may be credited with it, in
                           days from 1 to 90 (default: the project's setting)
      --by <network|campaign|adset|ad|surface>
                           What people are grouped by (default: campaign)
      --campaign <id>      Only people whose credited touch carried this campaign id
      --currency <code>    ISO 4217 code money is reported in (default: USD)
      --environment <production|sandbox|test>
                           Purchases revenue is read from: production, sandbox (App Store and Google
                           Play sandbox) or test (debug builds' simulated purchases and test modes
                           such as Stripe's) (default: production)
      --from <day>         First day to report on, YYYY-MM-DD (instead of --last)
  -h, --help               Show help for this command
      --json               Print the API report as JSON, for scripts
      --key-conversion <signup|trial|payer>
                           The conversion counted as KEY (default: the project's setting)
      --last <span>        The complete days before today to report on: a span such as 7d, 4w, 3m or
                           1y (default: 30d)
      --network <network>  Only people whose credited touch came from this network, such as meta
      --project <project>  Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name (default: this
                           directory's project, then your default project)
      --timezone <zone>    IANA time zone days are cut in, such as Europe/Prague (default: UTC)
      --to <day>           Last day to report on, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today; with --from)

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash analytics acquisition
  voidhash analytics acquisition --by network --last 90d
  voidhash analytics acquisition --by ad --campaign 120210000000000 --timezone Europe/Prague
  voidhash analytics acquisition --from 2026-10-01 --to 2026-10-31 --json
